Hard 打开原题 本地补充实现

docs.title: 快速复习
docs.text:
方法1：分治，归并排序

方法2：小根堆

docs.title: 详细题解
docs.text:
• 分治的方法：先拆分为两部分，每部分包含k/2个链表，递归得到这两部分的合并结果，然后再合并这两个链表

  • 小根堆的方法：把每条链表头放入小根堆；每次取最小节点接到结果，并把该节点后继入堆。

docs.title: Python 实现
docs.text:
import heapq
from itertools import count
# 方法1
class Solution:
    def mergeKList(self, lists, l, r):
        if l > r:
            return None
        if l == r:
            return lists[l]
        mid = (l + r) // 2
        left = self.mergeKList(lists, l, mid)
        right = self.mergeKList(lists, mid+1, r)
        dummy_head = tail = ListNode()
        while left and right:
            if left.val <= right.val:
                tail.next = left
                left = left.next
            else:
                tail.next = right
                right = right.next
            tail = tail.next
        tail.next = left or right
        return dummy_head.next
    def mergeKLists(self, lists: List[Optional[ListNode]]) -> Optional[ListNode]:
        return self.mergeKList(lists, 0, len(lists)-1)
# 方法2
class Solution:
    def mergeKLists(self, lists):
        heap = []
        for i,node in enumerate(lists):
            if node:
                # # 额外保存 i，这样即使 val 相同也不会去比 ListNode，避免报错
                heapq.heappush(heap, (node.val, i, node))
        dummy = tail = ListNode()
        while heap:
            _, i, node = heapq.heappop(heap)
            tail.next = node
            tail = node
            if node.next:
                heapq.heappush(heap, (node.next.val, i, node.next))
        return dummy.next

docs.title: 146. LRU 缓存
docs.text:
返回原专题题解 · Hot 100

Medium 打开原题 本地补充实现

docs.title: 快速复习
docs.text: 哈希表 O(1) 定位节点，双向链表 O(1) 移动和淘汰；最近使用放表头。

docs.title: 详细题解
docs.text: 高频考点，多练

docs.title: Python 实现
docs.text:
class LRUCacheNode:
    def __init__(self, key=0, value=0):
        self.key = key
        self.value = value
        self.prev = None
        self.next = None

class LRUCache:

    def __init__(self, capacity: int):
        self.size = 0
        self.capacity = capacity
        self.cache = {}
        self.head = LRUCacheNode()
        self.tail = LRUCacheNode()
        self.head.next = self.tail
        self.tail.prev = self.head


    def get(self, key: int) -> int:
        if key not in self.cache:
            return -1
        self.moveToHead(self.cache[key])
        return self.cache[key].value

    def put(self, key: int, value: int) -> None:
        if key in self.cache:
            self.cache[key].value = value
            self.moveToHead(self.cache[key])
            return
        if self.size == self.capacity:
            tail =self.tail.prev
            del self.cache[tail.key]
            tail.prev.next = self.tail
            self.tail.prev = tail.prev
            self.size -= 1
        node = LRUCacheNode(key, value)
        self.cache[key] = node
        self.size += 1
        self.addToHead(node)

    def moveToHead(self, node):
        node.prev.next = node.next
        node.next.prev = node.prev
        self.addToHead(node)

    def addToHead(self, node):
        node.next = self.head.next
        self.head.next.prev = node
        self.head.next = node
        node.prev = self.head

docs.title: 94. 二叉树的中序遍历
docs.text: Easy 打开原题 Hot 100 补充

docs.title: 快速复习
docs.text:
• 递归中序：先访问左子树，再访问节点，最后访问右子树
  • 迭代中序：不断把左链压栈，弹出节点访问，再转向右子树。

docs.title: 详细题解
docs.text: 迭代中序：栈保存尚未访问、但左子树已经准备处理的节点。当当前指针为空时弹栈访问，随后进入右子树，顺序自然是左—根—右。

docs.title: Python 实现
docs.text:
# 递归中序
class Solution:
    def traversal(self, root):
        if root is None:
            return
        self.traversal(root.left)
        self.result.append(root.val)
        self.traversal(root.right)

    def inorderTraversal(self, root: Optional[TreeNode]) -> List[int]:
        self.result = []
        self.traversal(root)
        return self.result

# 迭代中序
class Solution:
    def inorderTraversal(self, root: Optional[TreeNode]) -> List[int]:
        answer, stack = [], []
        current = root
        while current or stack:
            while current:
                stack.append(current)
                current = current.left
            current = stack.pop()
            answer.append(current.val)
            current = current.right
        return answer

docs.title: 详细题解
docs.text: 当前深度=max(左子树最大深度, 右子树最大深度) + 1

docs.title: Python 实现

class Solution:
    def maxDepth(self, root: Optional[TreeNode]) -> int:
        if root is None:
            return 0
        left_depth = self.maxDepth(root.left)
        right_depth = self.maxDepth(root.right)
        return max(left_depth, right_depth) + 1

# 递归实现
class Solution:
    def compare(self, node1, node2):
        if not node1 and not node2:
            return True
        if not node1 or not node2 or node1.val != node2.val:
            return False
        return self.compare(node1.left, node2.right) and self.compare(node1.right, node2.left)
    def isSymmetric(self, root: Optional[TreeNode]) -> bool:
        if root is None:
            return True
        return self.compare(root.left, root.right)
# 栈实现
class Solution:
    def isSymmetric(self, root: TreeNode) -> bool:
        if not root:
            return True
        st = [] #这里改成了栈
        st.append(root.left)
        st.append(root.right)
        while st:
            rightNode = st.pop()
            leftNode = st.pop()
            if not leftNode and not rightNode:
                continue
            if not leftNode or not rightNode or leftNode.val != rightNode.val:
                return False
            st.append(leftNode.left)
            st.append(rightNode.right)
            st.append(leftNode.right)
            st.append(rightNode.left)
        return True

class Solution:
    def depth(self, root) -> int:
        if not root:
            return 0
        left = self.depth(root.left)
        right = self.depth(root.right)
        self.ans = max(self.ans, left+right)
        return max(left, right) + 1

    def diameterOfBinaryTree(self, root: Optional[TreeNode]) -> int:
        self.ans = 0
        self.depth(root)
        return self.ans

        if root is None:
            return True

        left = self.isValidBST(root.left)

        if self.maxVal < root.val:
            self.maxVal = root.val

docs.title: 230. 二叉搜索树中第 K 小的元素
docs.text: Medium 打开原题 Hot 100 补充

docs.title: 快速复习
docs.text: 二叉搜索树中序遍历结果递增，访问到第 k 个节点即可返回。

docs.title: 详细题解
docs.text: 递归：中序遍历 栈：用栈执行迭代中序遍历，弹出一个节点就将 k 减一。因为不需要遍历后续节点，平均只访问到答案为止。

docs.title: Python 实现
docs.text:
# 递归
class Solution:
    def __init__(self):
        self.count = 0
    def kthSmallest(self, root: Optional[TreeNode], k: int) -> int:
        if not root:
            return None

        left = self.kthSmallest(root.left, k)

        self.count += 1
        if self.count == k:
            return root.val

        right = self.kthSmallest(root.right, k)

        if left is not None:
            return left
        if right is not None:
            return right
# 栈
class Solution:
    def kthSmallest(self, root: Optional[TreeNode], k: int) -> int:
        stack = []
        current = root
        while True:
            while current:
                stack.append(current)
                current = current.left
            current = stack.pop()
            k -= 1
            if k == 0:
                return current.val
            current = current.right

docs.text: Medium 打开原题 Hot 100 补充

docs.title: 快速复习
docs.text:
• 方法1：按右—左—根的逆前序递归，用 previous 保存已经展开好的链表头。
  • 方法2：
    • cur 左子树最右节点的右节点变为右子树
    • cur的left置空，right连左子树
    • cur = cur.right

docs.title: 详细题解
docs.text: 先展开右子树，再展开左子树。回到当前节点时令 node.right = previous、node.left = None，随后把当前节点设为新的 previous，最终得到前序顺序的右链。

docs.title: Python 实现
docs.text:
class Solution:
    def flatten(self, root: Optional[TreeNode]) -> None:
        previous = None

        def visit(node: Optional[TreeNode]) -> None:
            nonlocal previous
            if not node:
                return
            visit(node.right)
            visit(node.left)
            node.right = previous
            node.left = None
            previous = node

        visit(root)
# O(1)的做法
class Solution:

    def flatten(self, root: Optional[TreeNode]) -> None:
        """
        Do not return anything, modify root in-place instead.
        """
        cur = root
        while cur:
            if cur.left:
                nex = cur.left
                preNode = nex
                while preNode.right:
                    preNode = preNode.right
                preNode.right = cur.right
                cur.left = None
                cur.right = nex
            cur = cur.right

docs.text: Medium 打开原题 Hot 100 补充

docs.title: 快速复习
docs.text: 前序首元素确定根；用中序位置划分左右子树，并用哈希表 O(1) 查询位置。

docs.title: 详细题解
docs.text: 采用前序递归，维护前序下标，每次取出根值。在中序区间 [left,right] 中找到根的位置，然后递归构造左区间和右区间；前序下标会按根—左—右自然推进。

docs.title: Python 实现
docs.text:
class Solution:
    def buildTree(self, preorder: List[int], inorder: List[int]) -> Optional[TreeNode]:
        position = {value: i for i, value in enumerate(inorder)}
        preorder_index = 0

        def build(left: int, right: int) -> Optional[TreeNode]:
            nonlocal preorder_index
            if left > right:
                return None
            value = preorder[preorder_index]
            preorder_index += 1
            root = TreeNode(value)
            middle = position[value]
            root.left = build(left, middle - 1)
            root.right = build(middle + 1, right)
            return root

        return build(0, len(inorder) - 1)

from collections import defaultdict

class Solution:
    def pathSum(self, root, targetSum):
        count = defaultdict(int)
        count[0] = 1

        def dfs(node, prefix):
            if not node:
                return 0
            prefix += node.val
            answer = count[prefix - targetSum]
            count[prefix] += 1
            answer += dfs(node.left, prefix) + dfs(node.right, prefix)
            count[prefix] -= 1
            return answer

        return dfs(root, 0)

docs.title: 快速复习
docs.text: 递归只向父节点返回单边最大贡献，全局答案可同时接左右两边。

docs.title: 详细题解

• 只有子节点贡献值大于0，才纳入考虑
  • 返回的是节点贡献值

docs.title: Python 实现
docs.text:
class Solution:
    def __init__(self):
        self.maxSum = float("-inf")

    def maxPathSum(self, root: TreeNode) -> int:
        def maxGain(node):
            if not node:
                return 0

            # 递归计算左右子节点的最大贡献值
            # 只有在最大贡献值大于 0 时，才会选取对应子节点
            leftGain = max(maxGain(node.left), 0)
            rightGain = max(maxGain(node.right), 0)

            # 节点的最大路径和取决于该节点的值与该节点的左右子节点的最大贡献值
            priceNewpath = node.val + leftGain + rightGain

            # 更新答案
            self.maxSum = max(self.maxSum, priceNewpath)

            # 返回节点的最大贡献值
            return node.val + max(leftGain, rightGain)

        maxGain(root)
        return self.maxSum

docs.title: 详细题解
docs.text: 每次首次遇到 '1' 代表发现一座新岛。深度优先搜索将所有相连陆地改成 '0'，保证同一座岛不会重复计数，复杂度 O(mn)。

docs.text:
class Solution:
    def numIslands(self, grid: List[List[str]]) -> int:
        rows, cols = len(grid), len(grid[0])

        def flood(row: int, col: int) -> None:
            if row < 0 or row == rows or col < 0 or col == cols or grid[row][col] != "1":
                return
            grid[row][col] = "0"
            flood(row + 1, col)
            flood(row - 1, col)
            flood(row, col + 1)
            flood(row, col - 1)

        answer = 0
        for row in range(rows):
            for col in range(cols):
                if grid[row][col] == "1":
                    answer += 1
                    flood(row, col)
        return answer

docs.title: 快速复习

docs.title: 详细题解
docs.text: 把初始腐烂位置全部加入队列，相当于多个起点同时传播，统计最开始的新鲜橘子数量。每处理一层表示过去一分钟；感染新鲜橘子时将其数量减一，结束后仍有新鲜橘子则返回 -1。

docs.title: Python 实现
docs.text:
from collections import deque

class Solution:
    def orangesRotting(self, grid: List[List[int]]) -> int:
        rows, cols = len(grid), len(grid[0])
        queue = deque()
        fresh = 0
        for row in range(rows):
            for col in range(cols):
                if grid[row][col] == 2:
                    queue.append((row, col))
                elif grid[row][col] == 1:
                    fresh += 1
        minutes = 0
        while queue and fresh:
            for _ in range(len(queue)):
                row, col = queue.popleft()
                for dr, dc in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                    nr, nc = row + dr, col + dc
                    if 0 <= nr < rows and 0 <= nc < cols and grid[nr][nc] == 1:
                        grid[nr][nc] = 2
                        fresh -= 1
                        queue.append((nr, nc))
            minutes += 1
        return minutes if fresh == 0 else -1

from collections import deque

class Solution:
    def canFinish(self, numCourses: int, prerequisites: List[List[int]]) -> bool:
        graph = [[] for _ in range(numCourses)]
        indegree = [0] * numCourses
        for course, prerequisite in prerequisites:
            graph[prerequisite].append(course)
            indegree[course] += 1
        queue = deque(i for i, degree in enumerate(indegree) if degree == 0)
        visited = 0
        while queue:
            course = queue.popleft()
            visited += 1
            for following in graph[course]:
                indegree[following] -= 1
                if indegree[following] == 0:
                    queue.append(following)
        return visited == numCourses

class Trie:

    def __init__(self):
        self.children = {}
        self.is_word = False

    def insert(self, word: str) -> None:
        node = self
        for ch in word:
            if ch not in node.children:
                node.children[ch] = Trie()
            node = node.children[ch]
        node.is_word = True

    def _find(self, text):
        node = self
        for ch in text:
            if ch not in node.children:
                return None
            node = node.children[ch]
        return node

    def search(self, word: str) -> bool:
        node = self._find(word)
        return node is not None and node.is_word

    def startsWith(self, prefix: str) -> bool:
        node = self._find(prefix)
        return node is not None

docs.title: 46. 全排列
docs.text:
返回原专题题解 · 回溯算法

Medium 打开原题 代码随想录

docs.title: 快速复习
docs.text: 组合用 startIndex，排列用 used；保存结果时复制 path；区分树层和树枝去重。

docs.title: 详细题解
docs.text:
思路： 把问题画成决策树：for 循环横向枚举选择，递归纵向进入下一层，返回后撤销选择。 

# 回溯流程
void backtracking(参数) {
    if (终止条件) {
        存放结果;
        return;
    }

    for (选择：本层集合中元素（树中节点孩子的数量就是集合的大小）) {
        处理节点;
        backtracking(路径，选择列表); // 递归
        回溯，撤销处理结果
    }
}

docs.title: Python 实现
docs.text:
class Solution:
    def permute(self, nums):
        result = []
        self.backtracking(nums, [], [False] * len(nums), result)
        return result

    def backtracking(self, nums, path, used, result):
        if len(path) == len(nums):
            result.append(path[:])
            return
        for i in range(len(nums)):
            if used[i]:
                continue
            used[i] = True
            path.append(nums[i])
            self.backtracking(nums, path, used, result)
            path.pop()
            used[i] = False

class Solution:
    def subsets(self, nums):
        result = []
        path = []
        self.backtracking(nums, 0, path, result)
        return result

    def backtracking(self, nums, startIndex, path, result):
        result.append(path[:])  # 收集子集，要放在终止添加的上面，否则会漏掉自己
        # if startIndex >= len(nums):  # 终止条件可以不加
        #     return
        for i in range(startIndex, len(nums)):
            path.append(nums[i])
            self.backtracking(nums, i + 1, path, result)
            path.pop()

class Solution:
    def backTrack(self, idx, digits, num_char, result, path):
        if len(path) == len(digits):
            result.append("".join(path[:]))
            return
        for ch in num_char[digits[idx]]:
            path.append(ch)
            self.backTrack(idx+1, digits, num_char, result, path)
            path.pop()

    def letterCombinations(self, digits: str) -> List[str]:

            '4' : ['g', 'h', 'i'],

            '8' : ['t', 'u', 'v'],
            '9' : ['w', 'x', 'y', 'z'],
        }
        result = []
        self.backTrack(0, digits, num_char, result, [])
        return result

class Solution:
    def combinationSum(self, candidates: List[int], target: int) -> List[List[int]]:
        result =[]
        self.backtracking(candidates, target, 0, [], result)
        return result
    def backtracking(self, candidates, target, startIndex, path, result):
        if target == 0:
            result.append(path[:])
            return
        if target < 0:
            return
        for i in range(startIndex, len(candidates)):
            path.append(candidates[i])
            self.backtracking(candidates, target - candidates[i], i, path, result)
            path.pop()

docs.title: 22. 括号生成⭐
docs.text: Medium 打开原题 Hot 100 补充

docs.title: 快速复习
docs.text: 回溯维护已用左右括号数：左括号少于 n 可放左；右括号少于左括号才可放右。

docs.title: 详细题解
docs.text: 任何合法前缀都满足右括号数量不超过左括号。递归长度达到 2n 时收集答案，这两个剪枝条件保证只生成合法序列。

docs.title: Python 实现
docs.text:
class Solution:
    def generateParenthesis(self, n: int) -> List[str]:
        answer = []

        def backtrack(path: List[str], left: int, right: int) -> None:
            if len(path) == 2 * n:
                answer.append("".join(path))
                return
            if left < n:
                path.append("(")
                backtrack(path, left + 1, right)
                path.pop()
            if right < left:
                path.append(")")
                backtrack(path, left, right + 1)
                path.pop()

        backtrack([], 0, 0)
        return answer

docs.title: 79. 单词搜索
docs.text: Medium 打开原题 Hot 100 补充

docs.title: 快速复习
docs.text: 从每个可能起点 DFS，匹配一个字符后临时标记当前位置，向四周继续并在返回时恢复。

docs.title: 详细题解
docs.text: 递归参数保存当前位置和待匹配下标。越界或字符不同立即失败；匹配完成立即成功。临时修改网格可以防止一条路径重复使用同一格，回溯后恢复。

docs.title: Python 实现
docs.text:
class Solution:
    def exist(self, board: List[List[str]], word: str) -> bool:
        m = len(board)
        n = len(board[0])

        def dfs(row, col, index):
            if index == len(word):
                return True
            if not(0 <= row < m and 0 <= col < n):
                return False
            if board[row][col] != word[index]:
                return False
            ch = board[row][col]
            board[row][col] = '#'
            flag = any(dfs(row+dr, col+dc, index+1) for dr,dc in [(0,-1),(0,1),(-1,0),(1,0)])
            board[row][col] = ch
            return flag
        for i in range(m):
            for j in range(n):
                if dfs(i,j,0):
                    return True
        return False

补充思路： 把问题画成决策树：for 循环横向枚举选择，递归纵向进入下一层，返回后撤销选择。

docs.title: Python 实现
docs.text:
class Solution:

    def partition(self, s: str) -> List[List[str]]:
        result = []
        self.backtracking(s, 0, [], result)
        return result

    def backtracking(self, s, start_index, path, result ):
        # Base Case
        if start_index == len(s):
            result.append(path[:])
            return

        # 单层递归逻辑
        for i in range(start_index, len(s)):
            # 若反序和正序相同，意味着这是回文串
            if s[start_index: i + 1] == s[start_index: i + 1][::-1]:
                path.append(s[start_index:i+1])
                self.backtracking(s, i+1, path, result)   # 递归纵向遍历：从下一处进行切割，判断其余是否仍为回文串
                path.pop()             # 回溯

docs.title: 51. N 皇后
docs.text:
返回原专题题解 · 回溯算法

Hard 打开原题 代码随想录

docs.title: 快速复习
docs.text: 递归深度就是row控制棋盘的行，每一层里for循环的col控制棋盘的列

docs.title: 详细题解
docs.text:
递归深度就是row控制棋盘的行，每一层里for循环的col控制棋盘的列，一行一列，确定了放置皇后的位置。

每次都是要从新的一行的起始位置开始搜，所以都是从0开始。

docs.title: Python 实现
docs.text:
class Solution:
    def isValid(self, board, row, col, n):
        # 检查列
        for i in range(row):
            if board[i][col] == 'Q':
                return False
        # 检查左上
        i,j = row - 1, col - 1
        while i >= 0 and j >= 0:
            if board[i][j] == 'Q':
                return False
            i, j = i-1, j-1
        # 检查右上
        i,j = row - 1, col + 1
        while i >= 0 and j < n:
            if board[i][j] == 'Q':
                return False
            i, j = i-1, j+1 
        return True

    def backTrack(self, board, row, n, result):
        if row == n:
            result.append(["".join(cur_row) for cur_row in board])
            return
        for j in range(n):
            board[row][j] = 'Q'
            if self.isValid(board, row, j, n):
                self.backTrack(board, row+1, n, result)
            board[row][j] = '.'
    def solveNQueens(self, n: int) -> List[List[str]]:
        board = [["."]*n for _ in range(n)]
        result = []
        self.backTrack(board, 0, n, result)
        return result

docs.title: 35. 搜索插入位置
docs.text: Easy 打开原题 Hot 100 补充

docs.title: 快速复习
docs.text:
标准左边界二分：寻找第一个大于等于 target 的位置。

蓝红边界：大于等于 target 为红

docs.title: 详细题解
docs.text: 使用左闭右开区间 [left,right)。中间值小于目标时排除左半边，否则保留中点并收缩右边界；循环结束的 left 同时是命中位置或插入位置。

docs.title: Python 实现
docs.text:
# 左边界二分
class Solution:
    def searchInsert(self, nums: List[int], target: int) -> int:
        left, right = 0, len(nums)
        while left < right:
            middle = (left + right) // 2
            if nums[middle] < target:
                left = middle + 1
            else:
                right = middle
        return left
# 蓝红边界
class Solution:
    def searchInsert(self, nums: List[int], target: int) -> int:
        left = -1
        right = len(nums)
        while left + 1 != right:
            mid = (left+right) // 2
            if nums[mid] >= target:
                right = mid
            else:
                left = mid

        return right

docs.title: 74. 搜索二维矩阵
docs.text: Medium 打开原题 Hot 100 补充

docs.title: 快速复习
docs.text: 把矩阵视作长度 m*n 的有序数组，使用 row = mid // n、col = mid % n 映射。

docs.title: 详细题解
docs.text: 由于每行有序且下一行首元素大于上一行尾元素，按行展开后整体有序。无需真的展开数组，二分时通过除法和取模读取对应元素。

docs.title: Python 实现
docs.text:
class Solution:
    def searchMatrix(self, matrix: List[List[int]], target: int) -> bool:
        rows, cols = len(matrix), len(matrix[0])
        left, right = 0, rows * cols - 1
        while left <= right:
            middle = (left + right) // 2
            value = matrix[middle // cols][middle % cols]
            if value == target:
                return True
            if value < target:
                left = middle + 1
            else:
                right = middle - 1
        return False
# 蓝红边界
class Solution:
    def searchMatrix(self, matrix: List[List[int]], target: int) -> bool:
        m = len(matrix)
        n = len(matrix[0])
        left = -1
        right = m*n
        while left + 1 != right:
            mid = (left+right) // 2
            if matrix[mid//n][mid%n] >= target:
                right = mid
            else:
                left = mid
        if 0 <= right//n < m:
            return matrix[right//n][right%n] == target
        return False

docs.title: 34. 在排序数组中查找元素的第一个和最后一个位置
docs.text: Medium 打开原题 Hot 100 补充

docs.title: 快速复习
docs.text: 分别寻找 target 和 target + 1 的左边界，答案为 [left(target), left(target+1)-1]。

docs.title: 详细题解
docs.text: 通用 lower_bound 返回第一个大于等于给定值的位置。先确认第一个边界确实命中目标，再用第一个大于目标的位置减一得到右边界。

docs.title: Python 实现
docs.text:
class Solution:
    def searchRange(self, nums: List[int], target: int) -> List[int]:
        def lower_bound(value: int) -> int:
            left, right = 0, len(nums)
            while left < right:
                middle = (left + right) // 2
                if nums[middle] < value:
                    left = middle + 1
                else:
                    right = middle
            return left

        first = lower_bound(target)
        if first == len(nums) or nums[first] != target:
            return [-1, -1]
        return [first, lower_bound(target + 1) - 1]
# 蓝红边界
class Solution:
    def searchRange(self, nums: List[int], target: int) -> List[int]:
        def find_low(target):
            left = -1
            right = len(nums)
            while left+1 != right:
                mid = (left+right)//2
                if nums[mid] >= target:
                    right = mid
                else:
                    left = mid
            return right
        start = find_low(target)
        end = find_low(target+1)

        if end <= start:
            return [-1, -1]

        return [start, end-1]

Medium 打开原题 本地补充实现

docs.title: 快速复习
docs.text: 每轮判断哪一半有序，再检查 target 是否落在有序半区；所有比较使用一致的闭区间。

docs.title: 详细题解
docs.text: • 在判定左边是否有序时用的是≤，这样才能保证else分支中一定是右边有序。否则当left=mid时会有问题。如数组为[3,1]

docs.title: Python 实现
docs.text:
class Solution:
    def search(self, nums, target):
        left, right = 0, len(nums) - 1
        while left <= right:
            mid = (left + right) // 2
            if nums[mid] == target:
                return mid
            if nums[left] <= nums[mid]:
                if nums[left] <= target < nums[mid]:
                    right = mid - 1
                else:
                    left = mid + 1
            else:
                if nums[mid] < target <= nums[right]:
                    left = mid + 1
                else:
                    right = mid - 1
        return -1

docs.title: 153. 寻找旋转排序数组中的最小值
docs.text: Medium 打开原题 Hot 100 补充

docs.title: 快速复习
docs.text: 比较中点与右端点：中点更大说明最小值在右侧，否则最小值在含中点的左侧。

docs.title: 详细题解
docs.text: 保持最小值位于闭区间 [left,right]。当 nums[mid] > nums[right] 时中点仍在左侧递增段，令 left=mid+1；否则令 right=mid。

docs.title: Python 实现
docs.text:
class Solution:
    def findMin(self, nums: List[int]) -> int:
        left, right = 0, len(nums) - 1
        while left < right:
            middle = (left + right) // 2
            if nums[middle] > nums[right]:
                left = middle + 1
            else:
                right = middle
        return nums[left]

docs.title: 4. 寻找两个正序数组的中位数
docs.text:
返回原专题题解 · 数组

Hard 打开原题 本地补充实现

docs.title: 快速复习
docs.text: 把中位数转成寻找第 k 小；每轮排除一个数组中不可能包含答案的前 k/2 个元素。

docs.title: 详细题解
docs.text:
• 抓住寻找第k个元素的方法（比较或索引时采用的是闭区间）
  • 每次增加 k//2-1
  • new_index 为可淘汰的闭区间的右边界, 每次淘汰 new_index - index + 1 个

docs.title: Python 实现
docs.text:
class Solution:
    def findMedianSortedArrays(self, nums1: List[int], nums2: List[int]) -> float:

        m = len(nums1)
        n = len(nums2)
        def findkthMinNum(k):
            index1 = 0
            index2 = 0
            while True:
                if index1 >= m:
                    return nums2[index2+k-1]
                if index2 >= n:
                    return nums1[index1+k-1]
                if k == 1:
                    return min(nums1[index1], nums2[index2])
                new_index1 = min(index1+k//2-1, m-1)
                new_index2 = min(index2+k//2-1, n-1)
                if nums1[new_index1] > nums2[new_index2]:
                    k -= (new_index2 - index2 + 1)
                    index2 = new_index2 + 1
                else:
                    k -= (new_index1 - index1 + 1)
                    index1 = new_index1 + 1
        if (m+n) % 2 == 1:
            return findkthMinNum((m+n)//2+1)
        else:
            return (findkthMinNum((m+n)//2) + findkthMinNum((m+n)//2+1))/2

docs.title: Python 实现
docs.text:
class Solution:
    def isValid(self, s: str) -> bool:
        stack = []
        mapping = {
            '(': ')',
            '[': ']',
            '{': '}'
        }
        for item in s:
            if item in mapping.keys():
                stack.append(mapping[item])
            elif not stack or stack[-1] != item: 
                return False
            else: 
                stack.pop()
        return True if not stack else False

class MinStack:
    def __init__(self):
        self.data = []
        self.mins = []

    def push(self, val):
        self.data.append(val)
        self.mins.append(val if not self.mins else min(val, self.mins[-1]))

    def pop(self):
        self.mins.pop()
        return self.data.pop()

    def top(self):
        return self.data[-1]

    def getMin(self):
        return self.mins[-1]

class Solution:
    def decodeString(self, s):
        stack = []
        current = []
        number = 0
        for ch in s:
            if ch.isdigit():
                number = number * 10 + int(ch)
            elif ch == '[':
                stack.append((current, number))
                current, number = [], 0
            elif ch == ']':
                previous, repeat = stack.pop()
                current = previous + current * repeat
            else:
                current.append(ch)
        return ''.join(current)

class Solution:
    def dailyTemperatures(self, temperatures: List[int]) -> List[int]:
        answer = [0]*len(temperatures)
        stack = []

        return answer

while stack and heights[stack[-1]] > heights[i]:
    # print(stack)
    right = i
    mid = stack.pop()
    if stack:
        left = stack[-1]  # 这里left和right都是开区间
        area = (right-left-1)*heights[mid]
        # print(left, right, area)
        ans =max(ans, area)

开区间：当前方法求出的left和right是heights[mid]左边和右边第一个小于heights[mid]的数，因此不应该被包含进去，所以是开区间。对于接雨水同样也是开区间

为什么这里需要在头尾加上0的原因，而接雨水不用：因为接雨水的第一个柱子不可能盛水（不会形成凹槽）；而这里第一个柱子可能是面积的组成部分

# 暴力解法（leetcode超时）
class Solution:
    def largestRectangleArea(self, heights: List[int]) -> int:
        # 从左向右遍历：以每一根柱子为主心骨（当前轮最高的参照物），迭代直到找到左侧和右侧各第一个矮一级的柱子
        res = 0

        for i in range(len(heights)):
            left = i
            right = i
            # 向左侧遍历：寻找第一个矮一级的柱子
            for _ in range(left, -1, -1):
                if heights[left] < heights[i]:
                    break
                left -= 1
            # 向右侧遍历：寻找第一个矮一级的柱子
            for _ in range(right, len(heights)):
                if heights[right] < heights[i]:
                    break
                right += 1

            width = right - left - 1
            height = heights[i]
            res = max(res, width * height)

        return res

# 双指针 
class Solution:
    def largestRectangleArea(self, heights: List[int]) -> int:
        size = len(heights)
        # 两个DP数列储存的均是下标index
        min_left_index = [0] * size
        min_right_index = [0] * size
        result = 0

        # 记录每个柱子的左侧第一个矮一级的柱子的下标
        min_left_index[0] = -1  # 初始化防止while死循环
        for i in range(1, size):
            # 以当前柱子为主心骨，向左迭代寻找次级柱子
            temp = i - 1
            while temp >= 0 and heights[temp] >= heights[i]:
                # 当左侧的柱子持续较高时，尝试这个高柱子自己的次级柱子（DP
                temp = min_left_index[temp]
            # 当找到左侧矮一级的目标柱子时
            min_left_index[i] = temp

        # 记录每个柱子的右侧第一个矮一级的柱子的下标
        min_right_index[size-1] = size  # 初始化防止while死循环
        for i in range(size-2, -1, -1):
            # 以当前柱子为主心骨，向右迭代寻找次级柱子
            temp = i + 1
            while temp < size and heights[temp] >= heights[i]:
                # 当右侧的柱子持续较高时，尝试这个高柱子自己的次级柱子（DP
                temp = min_right_index[temp]
            # 当找到右侧矮一级的目标柱子时
            min_right_index[i] = temp

        for i in range(size):
            area = heights[i] * (min_right_index[i] - min_left_index[i] - 1)
            result = max(area, result)

        return result

# 单调栈
class Solution:
    def largestRectangleArea(self, heights: List[int]) -> int:
        # Monotonic Stack
        '''
        找每个柱子左右侧的第一个高度值小于该柱子的柱子
        单调栈：栈顶到栈底：从大到小（每插入一个新的小数值时，都要弹出先前的大数值）
        栈顶，栈顶的下一个元素，即将入栈的元素：这三个元素组成了最大面积的高度和宽度
        情况一：当前遍历的元素heights[i]大于栈顶元素的情况
        情况二：当前遍历的元素heights[i]等于栈顶元素的情况
        情况三：当前遍历的元素heights[i]小于栈顶元素的情况
        '''

        # 输入数组首尾各补上一个0（与42.接雨水不同的是，本题原首尾的两个柱子可以作为核心柱进行最大面积尝试
        heights.insert(0, 0)
        heights.append(0)
        stack = [0]
        result = 0
        for i in range(1, len(heights)):
            # 情况一
            if heights[i] > heights[stack[-1]]:
                stack.append(i)
            # 情况二
            elif heights[i] == heights[stack[-1]]:
                stack.pop()
                stack.append(i)
            # 情况三
            else:
                # 抛出所有较高的柱子
                while stack and heights[i] < heights[stack[-1]]:
                    # 栈顶就是中间的柱子，主心骨
                    mid_index = stack[-1]
                    stack.pop()
                    if stack:
                        left_index = stack[-1]
                        right_index = i
                        width = right_index - left_index - 1
                        height = heights[mid_index]
                        result = max(result, width * height)
                stack.append(i)
        return result

# 单调栈精简
class Solution:
    def largestRectangleArea(self, heights: List[int]) -> int:
        heights.insert(0,0)
        heights.append(0)
        stack = [0]
        ans = 0
        for i in range(1, len(heights)):
            while stack and heights[stack[-1]] >= heights[i]:
                # print(stack)
                right = i
                mid = stack.pop()
                if stack:
                    left = stack[-1]  # 这里left和right都是开区间
                    area = (right-left-1)*heights[mid]
                    # print(left, right, area)
                    ans =max(ans, area)
            stack.append(i)
        return ans

docs.title: 详细题解
docs.text: 逐个入堆，堆大小超过 k 时弹出最小值。扫描结束后堆中保留最大的 k 个元素，堆顶就是第 k 大，复杂度 O(n log k)。

import heapq

class Solution:
    def findKthLargest(self, nums: List[int], k: int) -> int:
        heap = []
        for value in nums:
            heapq.heappush(heap, value)
            if len(heap) > k:
                heapq.heappop(heap)
        return heap[0]

class Solution:
    def topKFrequent(self, nums: List[int], k: int) -> List[int]:
        count_dict = {}
        for num in nums:
            if num not in count_dict:
                count_dict[num] = 0
            count_dict[num] += 1

        pre_que = []
        for num,freq in count_dict.items():
            heapq.heappush(pre_que, (freq,num))
            if len(pre_que) > k:
                heapq.heappop(pre_que)

        return [num for freq,num in pre_que]

import heapq

class MedianFinder:

    def __init__(self):
        self.lower = [] # 最大堆，保存负数
        self.upper = [] # 最小堆


    def addNum(self, num: int) -> None:
        if not self.lower or num <= -self.lower[0]:
            heapq.heappush(self.lower, -num)
            if len(self.lower) > len(self.upper) + 1:
                heapq.heappush(self.upper, -heapq.heappop(self.lower))
        else:
            heapq,heappush(self.upper, num)
            if len(self.upper) > len(self.lower):
                heapq.heappush(self.lower, -heapq.heappop(self.upper))
        # print(self.lower, self.upper)


    def findMedian(self) -> float:
        if len(self.lower) > len(self.upper):
            return -self.lower[0]
        else:
            return (-self.lower[0] + self.upper[0]) / 2

        rightmost = 0

                return False
            rightmost = max(rightmost, i + nums[i])
            if i >= n - 1:

class Solution:
    def jump(self, nums: List[int]) -> int:
        n = len(nums)
        end = 0                 # 当前最远能到达的位置
        rightmost = 0           # 下一步最远能到达的位置
        count = 0
        for i in range(n-1):
            rightmost = max(rightmost, i+nums[i])
            if i == end:
                # print(rightmost)
                end = rightmost
                count += 1

        return count

class Solution:
    def partitionLabels(self, s: str) -> List[int]:
        last_occurrence = {}  # 存储每个字符最后出现的位置
        for i, ch in enumerate(s):
            last_occurrence[ch] = i

        result = []
        start = 0
        end = 0
        for i, ch in enumerate(s):
            end = max(end, last_occurrence[ch])  # 找到当前字符出现的最远位置
            if i == end:  # 如果当前位置是最远位置，表示可以分割出一个区间
                result.append(end - start + 1)
                start = i + 1

        return result

class Solution:
    def climbStairs(self, n: int) -> int:
        if n <= 1:
            return n

        dp = [0] * (n + 1)
        dp[1] = 1
        dp[2] = 2

        for i in range(3, n + 1):
            dp[i] = dp[i - 1] + dp[i - 2]

class Solution:
    def rob(self, nums: List[int]) -> int:
        n = len(nums)
        if n == 1:
            return nums[0]

        dp = [0] * n
        dp[0] = nums[0]
        dp[1] = max(nums[0],  nums[1])
        ans = dp[1]

        for i in range(2, n):
            dp[i] = max(dp[i-1], nums[i] + dp[i-2])
            ans = max(ans, dp[i])
        return ans
# 空间复杂度为O(1)的做法:
class Solution:
    def rob(self, nums: List[int]) -> int:
        if not nums:  # 如果没有房屋，返回0
            return 0

        prev_max = 0  # 上一个房屋的最大金额
        curr_max = 0  # 当前房屋的最大金额

        for num in nums:
            temp = curr_max  # 临时变量保存当前房屋的最大金额
            curr_max = max(prev_max + num, curr_max)  # 更新当前房屋的最大金额
            prev_max = temp  # 更新上一个房屋的最大金额

        return curr_max  # 返回最后一个房屋中可抢劫的最大金额

docs.text: 完全背包问题

docs.title: 详细题解
docs.text: 背包问题： - 二维递归公式：dp[i][j] = max(dp[i - 1][j], dp[i - 1][j - weight[i]] + value[i]) - 一维递归公式：dp[j] = max(dp[j], dp[j - weight[i]] + value[i]) - 默认采用外层外层循环为物品，内层循环为容量； - 是0-1背包还是完全背包：是0-1则内层循环倒序遍历，保证每样物品只被添加一次； - 是组合还是排列：是组合则先遍历物品再遍历容量；是排列则先遍历容量再遍历物品（物品的加入有顺序）

docs.title: Python 实现
docs.text:
class Solution:
    def numSquares(self, n: int) -> int:
        max_num = int(n ** 0.5)
        nums = []
        for i in range(1, max_num+1):
            nums.append(i**2)

        dp = [10e4] * (n+1)
        dp[0] = 0
        for i in range(len(nums)):
            for j in range(1, n+1):
                if j >= nums[i]:
                    dp[j] = min(dp[j], dp[j-nums[i]] + 1)
        return dp[n]

class Solution:
    def coinChange(self, coins: List[int], amount: int) -> int:
        dp = [10e4+1] * (amount + 1)
        dp[0] = 0

        for coin in coins:

class Solution:
    def wordBreak(self, s: str, wordDict: List[str]) -> bool:
        dp = [False]*(len(s) + 1)
        dp[0] = True
        # 遍历背包
        for j in range(1, len(s) + 1):
            # 遍历单词
            for word in wordDict:
                if j >= len(word):
                    dp[j] = dp[j] or (dp[j - len(word)] and word == s[j - len(word):j])
        return dp[len(s)]

class Solution:
    def lengthOfLIS(self, nums: List[int]) -> int:
        if len(nums) <= 1:
            return len(nums)
        dp = [1] * len(nums)
        result = 1
        for i in range(1, len(nums)):
            for j in range(0, i):
                if nums[i] > nums[j]:
                    dp[i] = max(dp[i], dp[j] + 1)
            result = max(result, dp[i]) #取长的子序列
        return result

class Solution:
    def maxProduct(self, nums):
        current_max = current_min = answer = nums[0]
        for value in nums[1:]:
            if value < 0:
                current_max, current_min = current_min, current_max
            current_max = max(value, current_max * value)
            current_min = min(value, current_min * value)
            answer = max(answer, current_max)
        return answer

docs.title: 详细题解
docs.text: 只要找到集合里能够出现 sum / 2 的子集总和，就算是可以分割成两个相同元素和子集了。

class Solution:
    def canPartition(self, nums: List[int]) -> bool:
        if sum(nums) % 2 != 0:
            return False
        target = sum(nums) // 2
        dp = [0] * (target + 1)
        for num in nums:
            for j in range(target, num-1, -1):
                dp[j] = max(dp[j], dp[j-num] + num)
        return dp[-1] == target

docs.title: 32. 最长有效括号
docs.text:
返回原专题题解 · Hot 100

Hard 打开原题 本地补充实现

docs.title: 快速复习
docs.text:
可以采用动态规划或栈，这里用栈比较容易理解。

关键：以「最后一个没有被匹配的右括号的下标」作为哨兵

docs.title: 详细题解
docs.text:
• 使用栈来操作
  • 始终保持栈底元素为当前已经遍历过的元素中「最后一个没有被匹配的右括号的下标」
    • 遇到 '(' 时，入栈
    • 遇到 ')' 时，出栈
      • 栈为空：说明刚刚把标记的右括号下标给弹出了，即当前 ')' 没有对应的 '('，压入当前下标作为「最后一个没有被匹配的右括号的下标」
      • 栈非空：更新答案
  • 一开始可以先垫一个-1入栈作为合法区间左边界哨兵(「最后一个没有被匹配的右括号的下标」)

docs.title: Python 实现
docs.text:
class Solution:
    def longestValidParentheses(self, s):
        stack = [-1]
        answer = 0
        for i, ch in enumerate(s):
            if ch == '(':
                stack.append(i)
            else:
                stack.pop()
                if not stack:
                    stack.append(i)
                else:
                    answer = max(answer, i - stack[-1])
        return answer

class Solution:
    def uniquePaths(self, m: int, n: int) -> int:
        dp = [[0] * n for _ in range(m)]
        for i in range(m):
            for j in range(n):
                if i == 0 and j == 0:
                    dp[0][0] = 1
                elif i == 0:
                    dp[i][j] = dp[i][j-1]
                elif j == 0:
                    dp[i][j] = dp[i-1][j]
                else:
                    dp[i][j] = dp[i-1][j] + dp[i][j-1]
        return dp[m-1][n-1]

class Solution:
    def minPathSum(self, grid: List[List[int]]) -> int:
        m = len(grid)
        n = len(grid[0])
        dp = [[0]*n for _ in range(m)]
        dp[0][0] = grid[0][0]
        for i in range(1, m):
            dp[i][0] = dp[i-1][0] + grid[i][0]
        for j in range(1, n):
            dp[0][j] = dp[0][j-1] + grid[0][j]
        for i in range(1, m):
            for j in range(1, n):
                dp[i][j] = min(dp[i-1][j], dp[i][j-1]) + grid[i][j]
        return dp[m-1][n-1]

docs.title: 5. 最长回文子串
docs.text:
返回原专题题解 · 动态规划

Medium 打开原题 代码随想录

docs.title: 快速复习
docs.text: dp[i][j]：字符串s在[i, j]范围内是不是回文

docs.title: 详细题解
docs.text:
dp[i][j]：字符串s在[i, j]范围内是不是回文。

  • dp[i][j] = dp[i+1][j-1] and s[i] == s[j]
  • 由短长度推出长长度，因此得从短长度开始遍历

docs.title: Python 实现
docs.text:
class Solution:
    def longestPalindrome(self, s: str) -> str:
        n = len(s)

        dp = [[False] *n for _ in range(n)]
        for i in range(n):
            dp[i][i] = True

        max_ans = s[0]
        max_len = 1
        for L in range(2, n+1):     # 枚举长度
            for i in range(n):      # 枚举左边界
                j = i + L - 1   # 右边界
                if j >= n:
                    break
                if L == 2:
                    dp[i][j] = s[i] == s[j]
                else:
                    dp[i][j] = dp[i+1][j-1] and s[i] == s[j]
                if dp[i][j] and L > max_len:
                    max_len = L
                    max_ans = s[i:j+1]
        return max_ans

docs.text: 这里要求的是序列，所以如果nums1[i-1]与nums2[i-1]不相等时也要更新，取二者较大值

docs.title: 详细题解
docs.text:
这里要求的是序列，所以如果nums1[i-1]与nums2[i-1]不相等时也要更新，取二者较大值 dp[i][j]：长度为i的串1与长度为j的串2 的最长公共子序列。

if nums1[i-1] == nums2[j-1]:
    dp[i][j] = dp[i-1][j-1] + 1
else:
    dp[i][j] = max(dp[i][j-1], dp[i-1][j])

docs.title: Python 实现
docs.text:
class Solution:
    def longestCommonSubsequence(self, text1: str, text2: str) -> int:
        # 创建一个二维数组 dp，用于存储最长公共子序列的长度
        dp = [[0] * (len(text2) + 1) for _ in range(len(text1) + 1)]

        # 遍历 text1 和 text2，填充 dp 数组
        for i in range(1, len(text1) + 1):
            for j in range(1, len(text2) + 1):
                if text1[i - 1] == text2[j - 1]:
                    # 如果 text1[i-1] 和 text2[j-1] 相等，则当前位置的最长公共子序列长度为左上角位置的值加一
                    dp[i][j] = dp[i - 1][j - 1] + 1
                else:
                    # 如果 text1[i-1] 和 text2[j-1] 不相等，则当前位置的最长公共子序列长度为上方或左方的较大值
                    dp[i][j] = max(dp[i - 1][j], dp[i][j - 1])

        # 返回最长公共子序列的长度
        return dp[len(text1)][len(text2)]

docs.text:
返回原专题题解 · 动态规划

Medium 打开原题 代码随想录

docs.title: 快速复习
docs.text: dp[i][j] 表示长度分别为i和j两个前缀的最少操作；末字符不同时从删、增、替换三种来源取最小值加一。

docs.title: 详细题解
docs.text:
之前的题目都只有删除操作，这里多了插入和替换操作，替换操作倒是容易实现，但插入却不行，总不能动态变化dp数组长度吧。

实际上对word1插入相当于对word2删除：题目要求对word1操作多次使其变为word2，但其实这些操作都是可逆的，例如对word1替换相当于对word2替换，对word1删除相当于对word2插入，对word1插入相当于对word2删除。因此在遇到需要对word1插入时，我们可以将其转化为对word2删除，从而规避掉插入操作。

注意边界情况：如dp[i][0] = i，表示对word1删除i次就变为空串，这样就和word2一样了

docs.title: Python 实现
docs.text:
class Solution:
    def minDistance(self, word1: str, word2: str) -> int:
        dp = [[0] * (len(word2)+1) for _ in range(len(word1)+1)]
        for i in range(len(word1)+1):
            dp[i][0] = i
        for j in range(len(word2)+1):
            dp[0][j] = j
        for i in range(1, len(word1)+1):
            for j in range(1, len(word2)+1):
                if word1[i-1] == word2[j-1]:
                    dp[i][j] = dp[i-1][j-1]
                else:
                    dp[i][j] = min(dp[i-1][j-1], dp[i-1][j], dp[i][j-1]) + 1
        return dp[-1][-1]

docs.title: 快速复习
docs.text: Boyer-Moore 抵消法：不同元素两两抵消，超过一半的候选最终不会被完全抵消。

docs.title: 详细题解
docs.text: Boyer-Moore 投票把当前候选人的票数记为 count。遇到相同元素就加一，遇到不同元素就减一；当票数归零时，说明此前元素已经两两抵消，可以从当前位置重新选择候选人。题目保证多数元素存在，因此最后留下的候选人就是答案。

docs.title: Python 实现
docs.text:
class Solution:
    def majorityElement(self, nums: List[int]) -> int:
        count = 0
        candidate = None

        for num in nums:
            if count == 0:
                candidate = num
            count += 1 if num == candidate else -1

        return candidate

docs.title: 75. 颜色分类
docs.text: Medium 打开原题 Hot 100 补充

docs.title: 快速复习
docs.text: 方法一： 先记录每个数的个数，后续直接填充 方法二： 荷兰国旗三指针：left 后放 0，right 前放 2，current 扫描未知区域。

docs.title: 详细题解
docs.text: 方法二： 遇到 0 与左边界交换并同时推进 left/current；遇到 2 与右边界交换，只收缩 right，因为换来的元素尚未检查；遇到 1 直接前进。

docs.title: Python 实现
docs.text:
# 方法1：
class Solution:
    def sortColors(self, nums: List[int]) -> None:
        """
        Do not return anything, modify nums in-place instead.
        """
        num_count = {
            0:0,
            1:0,
            2:0
        }
        for num in nums:
            num_count[num] += 1
        for i in range(len(nums)):
            if i < num_count[0]:
                nums[i] = 0
            elif i < num_count[0] + num_count[1]:
                nums[i] = 1
            else:
                nums[i] = 2
# 方法2：
class Solution:
    def sortColors(self, nums: List[int]) -> None:
        left = current = 0
        right = len(nums) - 1
        while current <= right:
            if nums[current] == 0:
                nums[left], nums[current] = nums[current], nums[left]
                left += 1
                current += 1
            elif nums[current] == 2:
                nums[current], nums[right] = nums[right], nums[current]
                right -= 1
            else:
                current += 1

class Solution:
    def nextPermutation(self, nums: List[int]) -> None:
        """
        Do not return anything, modify nums in-place instead.
        """
        n = len(nums)
        # 寻找左边较小数
        i = n-2
        while i >= 0 and nums[i] >= nums[i+1]:
            i -= 1
        # 寻找右边较大数
        if i >= 0:
            j = n-1
            while j >= 0 and nums[j] <= nums[i]:
                j -= 1
            nums[i], nums[j] = nums[j], nums[i]

        left,right = i+1,n-1
        while left <= right:
            nums[left], nums[right] = nums[right], nums[left]
            left += 1
            right -= 1

docs.text:
返回原专题题解 · Hot 100

Medium 打开原题 本地补充实现

docs.title: 快速复习
docs.text: 方法1：讲数字置为负数来标记 方法2：把下标当作节点，下标到数值看作链表指针，重复值对应环入口，用 Floyd 快慢指针定位（环形链表）。

docs.title: 详细题解
docs.text: 负数标记法利用数值对应的下标记录元素是否出现过，但会修改原数组。Floyd 方法则把 i -> nums[i] 看成链表中的指针：重复数字会让这张映射图形成环，先用快慢指针找到环内相遇点，再让一个指针从起点出发，两者同步前进，最终相遇的位置就是环入口，也就是重复数。

docs.title: Python 实现
docs.text:
# 方法1：
class Solution:
    def findDuplicate(self, nums: List[int]) -> int:
        for num in nums:
            idx = abs(num) - 1
            if nums[idx] < 0:       # 第二次访问
                return idx + 1
            nums[idx] = -nums[idx]  # 第一次访问时标记
# 方法2：
class Solution:
    def findDuplicate(self, nums: List[int]) -> int:
        fast = slow = 0
        while True:
            fast = nums[nums[fast]]     # 快指针
            slow = nums[slow]           # 慢指针
            if fast == slow:
                break
        cur = 0
        while cur != slow:      # 从起始节点和相交节点同步遍历，直至相遇
            cur = nums[cur]
            slow = nums[slow]
        return cur
